example.content:
const sourceUuid = await eda.dmt_Schematic.createSchematic();
await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500));

const copiedUuid = await eda.dmt_Schematic.copySchematic(sourceUuid);
await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500));

_source.title: 复制原理图
_source.remarks.text.0: 如若原理图已关联复用模块（在工程库内存在同名的复用模块符号），则复制原理图时将同步新建复用模块符号
_source.example.text.0: 1. 创建专用源原理图（自带图页 p1），等 1.5s 同步
_source.example.text.1: 2. 复制源原理图，返回副本 UUID
_source.example.text.2: 3. 回读副本，确认名称与图页被完整复制
_source.example.text.3: 4. 清理本例创建的两个原理图（先删副本再删源），保持工程整洁
_source.params.boardName: 新原理图所属板子名称，如若不指定则为游离原理图
_source.returns: 新原理图 UUID，如若为 `undefined` 则复制失败

title: Copy Schematic
remarks.text.0: If the schematic is already associated with a reuse block (a reuse block symbol with the same name exists in the project library), copying the schematic will also create a new reuse block symbol
params.boardName: Name of the board the new schematic belongs to. If not specified, it is a free schematic
returns: New schematic UUID. If it is `undefined`, the copy failed
